problem_description.description: The leader of some very secretive organization has decided to invite all other members to a meeting. All members of the organization live in the same town which can be represented as $$$n$$$ crossroads connected by $$$m$$$ two-directional streets. The meeting will be held in the leader's house near the crossroad $$$1$$$. There are $$$k$$$ members of the organization invited to the meeting; $$$i$$$-th of them lives near the crossroad $$$a_i$$$. All members of the organization receive the message about the meeting at the same moment and start moving to the location where the meeting is held. In the beginning of each minute each person is located at some crossroad. He or she can either wait a minute at this crossroad, or spend a minute to walk from the current crossroad along some street to another crossroad (obviously, it is possible to start walking along the street only if it begins or ends at the current crossroad). In the beginning of the first minute each person is at the crossroad where he or she lives. As soon as a person reaches the crossroad number $$$1$$$, he or she immediately comes to the leader's house and attends the meeting.Obviously, the leader wants all other members of the organization to come up as early as possible. But, since the organization is very secretive, the leader does not want to attract much attention. Let's denote the discontent of the leader as follows  initially the discontent is $$$0$$$;  whenever a person reaches the crossroad number $$$1$$$, the discontent of the leader increases by $$$c \cdot x$$$, where $$$c$$$ is some fixed constant, and $$$x$$$ is the number of minutes it took the person to reach the crossroad number $$$1$$$;  whenever $$$x$$$ members of the organization walk along the same street at the same moment in the same direction, $$$dx^2$$$ is added to the discontent, where $$$d$$$ is some fixed constant. This is not cumulative: for example, if two persons are walking along the same street in the same direction at the same moment, then $$$4d$$$ is added to the discontent, not $$$5d$$$. Before sending a message about the meeting, the leader can tell each member of the organization which path they should choose and where they should wait. Help the leader to establish a plan for every member of the organization so they all reach the crossroad $$$1$$$, and the discontent is minimized.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of the input contains five integer numbers $$$n$$$, $$$m$$$, $$$k$$$, $$$c$$$ and $$$d$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 50$$$, $$$n - 1 \le m \le 50$$$, $$$1 \le k, c, d \le 50$$$) — the number of crossroads, the number of streets, the number of persons invited to the meeting and the constants affecting the discontent, respectively. The second line contains $$$k$$$ numbers $$$a_1$$$, $$$a_2$$$, ..., $$$a_k$$$ ($$$2 \le a_i \le n$$$) — the crossroads where the members of the organization live. Then $$$m$$$ lines follow, each denoting a bidirectional street. Each line contains two integers $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$ ($$$1 \le x_i, y_i \le n$$$, $$$x_i \ne y_i$$$) denoting a street connecting crossroads $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$. There may be multiple streets connecting the same pair of crossroads. It is guaranteed that every crossroad can be reached from every other crossroad using the given streets.
problem_description.output_spec: Print one integer: the minimum discontent of the leader after everyone reaches crossroad $$$1$$$.
problem_description.notes: NoteThe best course of action in the first test is the following:  the first person goes along the street $$$2$$$ to the crossroad $$$2$$$, then goes along the street $$$1$$$ to the crossroad $$$1$$$ and attends the meeting;  the second person waits one minute on the crossroad $$$3$$$, then goes along the street $$$2$$$ to the crossroad $$$2$$$, then goes along the street $$$1$$$ to the crossroad $$$1$$$ and attends the meeting;  the third person waits two minutes on the crossroad $$$3$$$, then goes along the street $$$2$$$ to the crossroad $$$2$$$, then goes along the street $$$1$$$ to the crossroad $$$1$$$ and attends the meeting;  the fourth person waits three minutes on the crossroad $$$3$$$, then goes along the street $$$2$$$ to the crossroad $$$2$$$, then goes along the street $$$1$$$ to the crossroad $$$1$$$ and attends the meeting.

import sys
from collections import deque

N = 10000
M = N * 100
INF = 10**18

class FlowGraph:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = [-1] * N
        self.nxt = [-1] * M
        self.v = [0] * M
        self.c = [0] * M
        self.w = [0] * M
        self.ptr = 0
        self.t = 0
        self.cost = 0

    def padd_edge(self, uu, vv, ww, cc):
        self.v[self.ptr] = vv
        self.w[self.ptr] = ww
        self.c[self.ptr] = cc
        self.nxt[self.ptr] = self.head[uu]
        self.head[uu] = self.ptr
        self.ptr += 1

    def spfa(self, s, t):
        dis = [-1] * N
        vis = [False] * N
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        dis[s] = 0
        while q:
            nd = q.popleft()
            vis[nd] = False
            i = self.head[nd]
            while i != -1:
                if self.w[i] and (dis[self.v[i]] == -1 or dis[self.v[i]] > dis[nd] + self.c[i]):
                    dis[self.v[i]] = dis[nd] + self.c[i]
                    if not vis[self.v[i]]:
                        vis[self.v[i]] = True
                        q.append(self.v[i])
                i = self.nxt[i]
        return dis[t] != -1, dis

    def dfs(self, pos, flow, dis, vis, cur):
        if pos == self.t:
            return flow
        vis[pos] = True
        tmp = flow
        i = cur[pos] if cur[pos] != -1 else self.head[pos]
        while i != -1 and flow:
            if not vis[self.v[i]] and self.w[i] and dis[self.v[i]] == dis[pos] + self.c[i]:
                cur[pos] = i
                fl = self.dfs(self.v[i], min(flow, self.w[i]), dis, vis, cur)
                self.cost += fl * self.c[i]
                self.w[i] -= fl
                self.w[i ^ 1] += fl
                flow -= fl
            i = self.nxt[i]
        return tmp - flow

    def add_edge(self, uu, vv, ww, cc):
        self.padd_edge(uu, vv, ww, cc)
        self.padd_edge(vv, uu, 0, -cc)

    def dinic(self, s, t):
        self.cost = 0
        self.t = t
        while True:
            ok, dis = self.spfa(s, t)
            if not ok:
                break
            cur = [-1] * N
            vis = [False] * N
            self.dfs(s, INF, dis, vis, cur)
        return self.cost

INF = 1000000000

def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it); m = next(it); k = next(it); C = next(it); D = next(it)
    # read k people positions
    people = [0] * (k+1)
    for i in range(1, k+1):
        people[i] = next(it)
    # read m edges
    s = [None] * (2*m+1)  # 1-indexed
    for i in range(1, m+1):
        f = next(it); t = next(it)
        s[2*i] = (f, t)
        s[2*i-1] = (t, f)
    m *= 2

    # node indexing: P(x,y) = x*n + y, x from 0 to n+k, y from 1 to n
    def P(x, y):
        return x * n + y

    S = P(n+k, n) + 1
    T = S + 2
    max_node = T

    # graph arrays
    fir = [0] * (max_node + 1)
    g = [None]  # index 0 dummy
    tl = 1

    def add_edge(f, t, c, cost):
        nonlocal tl
        # forward edge
        g.append([fir[f], t, c, cost])
        fir[f] = tl
        tl += 1
        # backward edge
        g.append([fir[t], f, 0, -cost])
        fir[t] = tl
        tl += 1

    # initial edges
    add_edge(P(0, 1), T, INF, 0)
    for i in range(1, k+1):
        add_edge(S, P(0, people[i]), 1, 0)

    # time steps
    max_t = n + k  # assume this is correct (original code had n+n but likely typo)
    pl = [[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(max_t+2)]
    st = [[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(max_t+2)]

    for t in range(1, max_t+1):
        # stay edges
        for i in range(1, n+1):
            add_edge(P(t-1, i), P(t, i), INF, 0)
        # movement edges
        for i in range(1, m+1):
            u, v = s[i]
            add_edge(P(t-1, u), P(t, v), 1, D)
            pl[t][i] = tl - 2  # index of the forward edge (just added)
            st[t][i] = 1
        # sink edge
        add_edge(P(t, 1), T, INF, t * C)

    # SPFA and min-cost max-flow
    dis = [0] * (max_node + 1)
    flow = [0] * (max_node + 1)
    pre = [0] * (max_node + 1)
    lp = [0] * (max_node + 1)
    inq = [False] * (max_node + 1)

    def spfa():
        for i in range(1, T+1):
            dis[i] = INF
            flow[i] = 0
        flow[S] = INF
        dis[S] = 0
        q = deque()
        q.append(S)
        inq[S] = True
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            inq[u] = False
            i = fir[u]
            while i:
                v = g[i][1]
                if g[i][2] > 0 and dis[v] > dis[u] + g[i][3]:
                    dis[v] = dis[u] + g[i][3]
                    flow[v] = min(flow[u], g[i][2])
                    lp[v] = i
                    pre[v] = u
                    if not inq[v]:
                        inq[v] = True
                        q.append(v)
                i = g[i][0]
        return flow[T]

    cans = 0
    while True:
        sav = spfa()
        if sav == 0:
            break
        u = T
        while u != S:
            las = pre[u]
            g[lp[u]][2] -= sav
            g[lp[u] ^ 1][2] += sav
            u = las
        cans += dis[T] * sav
        # update edges for next use

                    st[t][i] += 1
                    u, v = s[i]
                    add_edge(P(t-1, u), P(t, v), 1, D * (st[t][i] * 2 - 1))
                    pl[t][i] = tl - 2

    print(cans)

import sys
from collections import deque

INF = 10**14

def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    m = next(it)
    k = next(it)
    c = next(it)
    d = next(it)

    # nodes: source=0, then time layers: for time i (0..104) we have n nodes (city 0..n-1)
    # node index = i*n + city + 1 (since source is 0)
    # sink = 105*n + 1
    T = 105  # number of time steps (0..104)
    sink = T * n + 1
    nodes = sink + 1  # total nodes: 0..sink inclusive

    g = [[] for _ in range(nodes)]
    e = []  # list of edges: [u, v, cap, flow, cost]

    def add_edge(u, v, cap, cost):
        g[u].append(len(e))
        e.append([u, v, cap, 0, cost])
        g[v].append(len(e))
        e.append([v, u, 0, 0, -cost])

    # source to starting positions
    for _ in range(k):
        x = next(it) - 1
        add_edge(0, x + 1, 1, 0)

    # roads
    for _ in range(m):
        x = next(it) - 1
        y = next(it) - 1
        for i in range(T):
            for j in range(51):
                add_edge(i * n + x + 1, (i + 1) * n + y + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1))
                add_edge(i * n + y + 1, (i + 1) * n + x + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1))

    # stay in place edges
    for i in range(T):
        for j in range(n):
            add_edge(i * n + j + 1, (i + 1) * n + j + 1, 51, c)

    # edges from each time's city 1 to sink
    for i in range(T):
        add_edge(i * n + 1, sink, 51, 0)

    # min-cost max-flow (successive shortest augmenting path)
    dist = [INF] * nodes
    pre = [-1] * nodes
    cap = [0] * nodes
    inq = [False] * nodes
    mxflow = 0
    mncost = 0

    while True:
        # SPFA
        for i in range(nodes):
            dist[i] = INF
            pre[i] = -1
            cap[i] = 0
            inq[i] = False
        dist[0] = 0
        pre[0] = 0
        cap[0] = INF
        q = deque()
        q.append(0)
        inq[0] = True
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            inq[u] = False
            for idx in g[u]:
                f = e[idx]
                if f[2] - f[3] > 0 and dist[f[1]] > dist[u] + f[4] + 1e-9:
                    dist[f[1]] = dist[u] + f[4]

INF = 10**9+7

class Edge:
    __slots__ = ('from', 'to', 'cap', 'flow', 'cost')
    def __init__(self, from_, to_, cap, flow, cost):
        self.from_ = from_
        self.to_ = to_
        self.cap = cap
        self.flow = flow
        self.cost = cost

class MCMF:
    def __init__(self):
        self.n = 0
        self.m = 0
        self.e = []
        self.g = [[]]
        self.inq = []
        self.d = []
        self.p = []
        self.flow_a = []

    def Init(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.g = [[] for _ in range(n+1)]
        self.e.clear()

    def add(self, from_, to_, cap, cost):
        self.e.append(Edge(from_, to_, cap, 0, cost))
        self.e.append(Edge(to_, from_, 0, 0, -cost))
        self.m = len(self.e)
        self.g[from_].append(self.m-2)
        self.g[to_].append(self.m-1)

    def bellman(self, s, t):
        self.d = [INF] * (self.n+1)
        self.inq = [0] * (self.n+1)
        self.p = [0] * (self.n+1)
        self.flow_a = [0] * (self.n+1)
        self.d[s] = 0
        self.inq[s] = 1
        self.p[s] = 0
        self.flow_a[s] = INF
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            self.inq[u] = 0
            for ei in self.g[u]:
                ee = self.e[ei]
                if ee.cap > ee.flow and self.d[ee.to_] > self.d[u] + ee.cost:
                    self.d[ee.to_] = self.d[u] + ee.cost
                    self.p[ee.to_] = ei
                    self.flow_a[ee.to_] = min(self.flow_a[u], ee.cap - ee.flow)
                    if not self.inq[ee.to_]:
                        q.append(ee.to_)
                        self.inq[ee.to_] = 1
        if self.d[t] == INF:
            return False
        flow_add = self.flow_a[t]
        cost_add = self.d[t] * flow_add
        # We'll return flow and cost to accumulate in minCost
        u = t
        while u != s:
            ei = self.p[u]
            self.e[ei].flow += flow_add
            self.e[ei^1].flow -= flow_add
            u = self.e[ei].from_
        return flow_add, cost_add

    def minCost(self, s, t):
        flow = 0
        cost = 0
        while True:
            ret = self.bellman(s, t)
            if ret is False:
                break
            f, c = ret
            flow += f
            cost += c
        return cost

    def mcf_update(self, s, t):
        dist = [INF] * self.N
        vis = [False] * self.N

            self.flo[e] += df
            self.flo[e ^ 1] -= df
            i = self.ep[e ^ 1]
        # update potentials
        for i in range(self.N):
            if dist[i] < INF:
                self.pot[i] += dist[i]
            else:
                self.pot[i] = INF
        return df

                e[1] -= d

                v = prevv[v]
        return res

import sys
from collections import deque

def solve() -> None:
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    m = next(it)
    k = next(it)
    c = next(it)
    d = next(it)
    lim = 101

    N = 10005
    S = N - 2
    T = N - 1
    INF = 10**18

    head = [0] * N
    to = [0]
    nxt = [0]
    w = [0]
    cost_arr = [0]
    cnt = 1

    def add_edge(x: int, y: int, flow: int, cost: int) -> None:
        nonlocal cnt
        to.append(y)
        nxt.append(head[x])
        head[x] = cnt
        w.append(flow)
        cost_arr.append(cost)
        cnt += 1
        to.append(x)
        nxt.append(head[y])
        head[y] = cnt
        w.append(0)
        cost_arr.append(-cost)
        cnt += 1

    # read starting positions
    for _ in range(k):
        x = next(it) - 1
        add_edge(S, x, 1, 0)

    # sink edges from node 0 at each time step
    for i in range(lim):
        add_edge(i * n, T, k, c * i)

    # stay edges (same node, consecutive time)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(lim - 1):
            add_edge(i + j * n, i + (j + 1) * n, k, 0)

    # road edges
    for _ in range(m):
        x = next(it) - 1
        y = next(it) - 1
        for i in range(lim - 1):
            for j in range(k - 1, -1, -1):
                cost = d * (2 * j + 1)
                add_edge(x + i * n, y + (i + 1) * n, 1, cost)
                add_edge(y + i * n, x + (i + 1) * n, 1, cost)

    # SPFA and DFS for min-cost flow
    mark = [False] * N
    dis = [0] * N

    def spfa() -> bool:
        nonlocal mark, dis
        mark = [False] * N
        dis = [INF] * N
        q = deque()
        q.append(T)
        dis[T] = 0
        mark[T] = True
        while q:
            x = q.popleft()
            mark[x] = False
            i = head[x]
            while i:
                y = to[i]
                if w[i ^ 1] > 0 and dis[y] > dis[x] + cost_arr[i ^ 1]:
                    dis[y] = dis[x] + cost_arr[i ^ 1]
                    if not mark[y]:
                        q.append(y)
                        mark[y] = True
                i = nxt[i]
        return dis[S] < INF

    def dfs(x: int, lim_flow: int, total_cost: list) -> int:
        flow = 0
        mark[x] = True
        if x == T:
            return lim_flow
        i = head[x]
        while i:
            y = to[i]
            if w[i] > 0 and not mark[y] and dis[x] == dis[y] + cost_arr[i]:
                t = dfs(y, min(w[i], lim_flow - flow), total_cost)
                w[i] -= t
                w[i ^ 1] += t
                flow += t
                total_cost[0] += t * cost_arr[i]
                if flow == lim_flow:
                    return lim_flow
            i = nxt[i]
        return flow

    def costflow() -> int:
        flow = 0
        total_cost = [0]
        while spfa():
            while True:
                mark = [False] * N
                flow += dfs(S, 10**9, total_cost)
                if not mark[T]:
                    break
        return total_cost[0]

    print(costflow())

    solve()

import sys
import heapq
from typing import List, Tuple, Optional, Union, Dict, Any

# Base class of flow algorithms
class flow_base:
    class edge_t:
        __slots__ = ('src', 'dst', 'cap', 'cost', 'rev')
        def __init__(self, src: int, dst: int, cap: int, cost: int, rev: Optional['flow_base.edge_t']):
            self.src = src
            self.dst = dst
            self.cap = cap
            self.cost = cost
            self.rev = rev

    def __init__(self, n: int = 0):
        self.adj: List[List[flow_base.edge_t]] = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def copy_adj(self, other: 'flow_base') -> None:
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(len(other.adj))]
        for node in range(len(other.adj)):
            for e in other.adj[node]:
                if e.src == node:
                    self.adj[e.src].append(type(e)(e.src, e.dst, e.cap, e.cost, None))
                    self.adj[e.dst].append(type(e)(e.dst, e.src, 0, -e.cost, None))
                    self.adj[e.src][-1].rev = self.adj[e.dst][-1]
                    self.adj[e.dst][-1].rev = self.adj[e.src][-1]
                    e.rev.src = -1
                else:
                    e.rev.rev.src = node

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.adj)

    def __getitem__(self, node: int) -> List[edge_t]:
        assert 0 <= node < self.size()
        return self.adj[node]

    def add_edge(self, src: int, dst: int, cap: int, cost: int) -> None:
        assert 0 <= src < self.size()
        assert 0 <= dst < self.size()
        if cap <= 0:
            return
        self.adj[src].append(flow_base.edge_t(src, dst, cap, cost, None))
        self.adj[dst].append(flow_base.edge_t(dst, src, 0, -cost, None))
        self.adj[src][-1].rev = self.adj[dst][-1]
        self.adj[dst][-1].rev = self.adj[src][-1]

class min_cost_flow(flow_base):
    def __init__(self, n: int = 0):
        super().__init__(n + 2)
        self.min_cost: int = 0
        self.total_cost: int = 0
        self.supp: List[int] = [0] * (n + 2)
        self.ptnl: List[int] = [0] * (n + 2)
        self.dist: List[int] = [0] * (n + 2)
        self.last: List[Optional[flow_base.edge_t]] = [None] * (n + 2)

    def copy_member(self, other: 'min_cost_flow') -> None:
        self.min_cost = other.min_cost
        self.total_cost = other.total_cost
        self.supp = other.supp[:]
        self.ptnl = other.ptnl[:]

    def dijkstra(self, src: int, dst: int) -> bool:
        infty = self.total_cost + 1
        self.dist = [infty] * self.size()
        self.dist[src] = 0
        pq = [(0, src)]
        while pq:
            ndist, now = heapq.heappop(pq)
            ndist = -ndist
            if ndist != self.dist[now]:
                continue
            self.ptnl[now] += ndist
            self.dist[now] = -1
            for e in self.adj[now]:
                if self.dist[e.dst] == -1 or e.cap == 0:
                    continue
                if self.dist[e.dst] + self.ptnl[e.dst] > self.ptnl[now] + e.cost:
                    self.dist[e.dst] = self.ptnl[now] + e.cost - self.ptnl[e.dst]
                    self.last[e.dst] = e
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (-self.dist[e.dst], e.dst))
        return self.dist[dst] == -1

    def size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.adj) - 2

    def add_edge(self, src: int, dst: int, cap: int, cost: int) -> None:
        assert src != dst
        if cap <= 0:
            return
        if cost < 0:
            self.supp[src] -= cap
            self.supp[dst] += cap
            self.min_cost += cap * cost
            self.total_cost -= cap * cost
            super().add_edge(dst, src, cap, -cost)
        else:
            self.total_cost += cap * cost
            super().add_edge(src, dst, cap, cost)

    def supply(self, node: int, vol: int) -> None:
        self.supp[node] += vol

    def solve(self) -> bool:
        assert len(self.adj) > 1
        src = len(self.adj) - 2
        dst = src + 1
        flow = 0
        supp_sum = 0
        for node in range(len(self.adj)):
            supp_sum += self.supp[node]
            if self.supp[node] > 0:
                flow += self.supp[node]
                super().add_edge(src, node, self.supp[node], 0)
            elif self.supp[node] < 0:
                super().add_edge(node, dst, -self.supp[node], 0)
            self.supp[node] = 0
        if supp_sum != 0:
            return False
        while flow > 0:
            if not self.dijkstra(src, dst):
                return False
            resid = flow
            node = dst
            while node != src:
                resid = min(resid, self.last[node].cap)
                node = self.last[node].src
            flow -= resid
            self.min_cost += self.ptnl[dst] * resid
            node = dst
            while node != src:
                self.last[node].cap -= resid
                self.last[node].rev.cap += resid
                node = self.last[node].src
        return True

    def optimal(self) -> int:
        self.solve()
        return self.min_cost

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(input_data)
    n = int(next(it))
    m = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    c = int(next(it))
    d = int(next(it))
    
    mcf = min_cost_flow(6100)
    tlim = 105
    
    for _ in range(k):
        j = int(next(it)) - 1
        mcf.supply(j, 1)
    
    for _ in range(m):
        u = int(next(it)) - 1
        v = int(next(it)) - 1
        for t in range(tlim):
            nu = u + n
            nv = v + n
            for x in range(k):
                mcf.add_edge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (2 * x + 1))
                mcf.add_edge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (2 * x + 1))
            u = nu

    for t in range(tlim + 1):
        mcf.add_edge(t * n, dst, k, 0)
    
    print(mcf.optimal())

import sys
import heapq

class Flow:
    def __init__(self, N):
        self.N = N
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(N)]
        self.sz = [0] * N
        self.mc = 0
        self.vis = [False] * N
        self.par = [0] * N
        self.pot = [0] * N
        self.dist = [0] * N

    def init(self, n=None):
        if n is None:
            n = self.N
        self.mc = 0
        self.sz = [0] * n
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add_edge(self, a, b, c=1, p=0):
        self.mc = max(self.mc, c)
        # forward edge: [to, rev_index, flow, cap, cost]
        self.adj[a].append([b, len(self.adj[b]), 0, c, p])
        # backward edge
        self.adj[b].append([a, len(self.adj[a]) - 1, 0, 0, -p])

    def mcf(self, s, t, price, n, sparse):
        INF = 10**18
        self.vis = [False] * n
        self.dist = [INF] * n
        self.dist[s] = 0
        if sparse:
            pq = [(0, s)]
            while pq:
                d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
                if self.vis[u]:
                    continue
                self.vis[u] = True
                for e in self.adj[u]:
                    if e[2] < e[3]:  # f < c
                        nd = self.dist[u] + self.pot[u] - self.pot[e[0]] + e[4]
                        if self.dist[e[0]] > nd:
                            self.dist[e[0]] = nd
                            self.par[e[0]] = e[1]
                            heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, e[0]))
        else:
            for _ in range(n):
                u = -1
                best = INF
                for i in range(n):
                    if not self.vis[i] and self.dist[i] < best:
                        best = self.dist[i]
                        u = i
                if u == -1:
                    break
                self.vis[u] = True
                for e in self.adj[u]:
                    if e[2] < e[3]:
                        nd = self.dist[u] + self.pot[u] - self.pot[e[0]] + e[4]
                        if self.dist[e[0]] > nd:
                            self.dist[e[0]] = nd
                            self.par[e[0]] = e[1]
        if self.dist[t] >= INF:
            return 0
        df = INF
        u = t
        while u != s:
            r = self.adj[u][self.par[u]]
            forward = self.adj[r[0]][r[1]]
            df = min(df, forward[3] - forward[2])
            u = r[0]
        u = t
        while u != s:
            r = self.adj[u][self.par[u]]
            forward = self.adj[r[0]][r[1]]
            forward[2] += df
            r[2] -= df
            price[0] += df * forward[4]
            u = r[0]
        for i in range(n):
            self.pot[i] = min(INF, self.dist[i] + self.pot[i])
        return df

    def min_cost_flow(self, s, t, n=None, sparse=False):
        if n is None:
            n = self.N
        flow = 0
        price = [0]
        while True:
            df = self.mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse)
            if df == 0:
                break
            flow += df
        return flow, price[0]

import sys
import heapq
from collections import deque

INF = 10**18

class MCMF:
    def __init__(self):
        self.n = 0
        self.g = []  # list of lists of [v, rev, cap, cost]
        self.pot = []
        self.dis = []
        self.vis = []
        self.cur = []

    def addv(self, cnt):
        for _ in range(cnt):
            self.g.append([])
            self.n += 1
        return self.n - 1

    def adde(self, u, v, cap, cost):
        # forward edge
        self.g[u].append([v, len(self.g[v]), cap, cost])
        # reverse edge
        self.g[v].append([u, len(self.g[u]) - 1, 0, -cost])

    def _dijkstra(self, s, t):
        self.dis = [INF] * self.n
        self.vis = [0] * self.n
        pq = [(0, s)]
        self.dis[s] = 0
        while pq:
            du, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
            if self.vis[u]:
                continue
            self.vis[u] = 1
            for e in self.g[u]:
                v, rev, cap, w = e
                if cap == 0:
                    continue
                dv = du + self.pot[u] + w - self.pot[v]
                if self.vis[v] or self.dis[v] <= dv:
                    continue
                self.dis[v] = dv
                heapq.heappush(pq, (dv, v))
        return self.vis[t]

    def _dinic_bfs(self, s, t):
        self.vis = [0] * self.n
        q = deque([s])
        self.vis[s] = 1
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            for e in self.g[u]:
                v, rev, cap, w = e
                if self.vis[v] or cap == 0:
                    continue
                if self.dis[v] != self.dis[u] + w - self.pot[v] + self.pot[u]:
                    continue
                self.vis[v] = self.vis[u] + 1
                q.append(v)
        return self.vis[t] != 0

    def _dinic_dfs(self, u, t, f):
        if u == t:
            return f
        sf = 0
        i = self.cur[u]
        while i < len(self.g[u]):
            e = self.g[u][i]
            v, rev, cap, w = e
            if cap and self.vis[v] == self.vis[u] + 1:
                if self.dis[v] == self.dis[u] + w - self.pot[v] + self.pot[u]:
                    df = self._dinic_dfs(v, t, min(cap, f))
                    if df:
                        sf += df
                        f -= df
                        e[2] -= df
                        self.g[v][rev][2] += df
                        if f == 0:
                            break
            i += 1
            self.cur[u] = i
        return sf

    def mincostflow(self, s, t, maxf):
        flow = 0
        cost = 0
        self.pot = [0] * self.n
        while self._dijkstra(s, t):
            f = 0
            while self._dinic_bfs(s, t):
                self.cur = [0] * self.n
                df = self._dinic_dfs(s, t, maxf)
                maxf -= df
                f += df
                if maxf == 0:
                    break
            flow += f
            cost += (self.dis[t] + self.pot[t]) * f
            for i in range(self.n):
                self.pot[i] += self.dis[i]
            if maxf == 0:
                break
        return flow, cost


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    m = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    c = int(next(it))
    d = int(next(it))
    l = max(n, k) * 2

    mcmf = MCMF()
    mcmf.addv(l * n)
    s = mcmf.addv(1)
    t = mcmf.addv(1)

    for _ in range(k):
        a = int(next(it)) - 1
        mcmf.adde(s, a, 1, 0)

    for _ in range(m):
        u = int(next(it)) - 1
        v = int(next(it)) - 1
        for i in range(l - 1):
            u1 = u + i * n
            v1 = v + (i + 1) * n
            u2 = u + (i + 1) * n
            v2 = v + i * n
            for j in range(k):
                cost_edge = c + d * (2 * j + 1)
                mcmf.adde(u1, v1, 1, cost_edge)
                mcmf.adde(v2, u2, 1, cost_edge)

    for i in range(l - 1):
        for j in range(n):
            u = j + i * n
            v = j + (i + 1) * n
            mcmf.adde(u, v, INF, c)

    for i in range(l):
        mcmf.adde(i * n, t, INF, 0)

    flow, cost = mcmf.mincostflow(s, t, INF)
    print(cost)

import sys
import heapq

INF = 10**18

class Edge:
    __slots__ = ('to', 'rev', 'cap', 'flow', 'cost')
    def __init__(self, to, rev, cap, flow, cost):
        self.to = to
        self.rev = rev
        self.cap = cap
        self.flow = flow
        self.cost = cost

class Flow:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.pot = [0] * n
        self.dist = [0] * n
        self.prevv = [0] * n
        self.preve = [0] * n

    def add_edge(self, fr, to, cap, cost):
        self.adj[fr].append(Edge(to, len(self.adj[to]), cap, 0, cost))
        self.adj[to].append(Edge(fr, len(self.adj[fr]) - 1, 0, 0, -cost))

    def min_cost_flow(self, s, t, maxf):
        n = self.n
        pot = self.pot
        dist = self.dist
        prevv = self.prevv
        preve = self.preve
        flow = 0
        cost = 0
        # initialize potentials (all costs >= 0, so no need for Bellman-Ford)
        # scaling
        lb = 1 << 30
        while lb > 0:
            while True:
                # Dijkstra
                dist = [INF] * n
                dist[s] = 0
                pq = [(0, s)]
                while pq:
                    d, v = heapq.heappop(pq)
                    if dist[v] < d:
                        continue
                    for i, e in enumerate(self.adj[v]):
                        if e.cap - e.flow >= lb and dist[e.to] > dist[v] + pot[v] - pot[e.to] + e.cost:
                            dist[e.to] = dist[v] + pot[v] - pot[e.to] + e.cost
                            prevv[e.to] = v
                            preve[e.to] = i
                            heapq.heappush(pq, (dist[e.to], e.to))
                if dist[t] == INF:
                    break
                # update potentials
                for v in range(n):
                    if dist[v] < INF:
                        pot[v] += dist[v]
                    else:
                        pot[v] = INF
                # find augmentable flow
                d = maxf - flow
                v = t
                while v != s:
                    e = self.adj[prevv[v]][preve[v]]
                    d = min(d, e.cap - e.flow)
                    v = prevv[v]
                # augment
                v = t
                while v != s:
                    e = self.adj[prevv[v]][preve[v]]
                    e.flow += d
                    self.adj[v][e.rev].flow -= d
                    cost += d * e.cost
                    v = prevv[v]
                flow += d
                if flow == maxf:
                    return flow, cost
            lb //= 2
        return flow, cost

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    m = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    c = int(next(it))

def read_ints():

class MinCostMaxFlow:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.INF = 10**9

    def add_edge(self, fr, to, cap, cost):
        forward = [to, len(self.graph[to]), cap, cost]
        backward = [fr, len(self.graph[fr]), 0, -cost]
        self.graph[fr].append(forward)
        self.graph[to].append(backward)

    def spfa(self, s, t):
        n = self.n
        INF = self.INF
        dis = [INF] * n
        inqueue = [False] * n
        q = [s]
        dis[s] = 0
        inqueue[s] = True
        while q:
            v = q.pop(0)
            inqueue[v] = False
            for to, rev, cap, cost in self.graph[v]:
                if cap > 0 and dis[to] > dis[v] + cost:
                    dis[to] = dis[v] + cost
                    if not inqueue[to]:
                        inqueue[to] = True
                        q.append(to)
        return dis[t] != INF, dis

    def dfs(self, v, t, f, dis, vis):
        if v == t:
            return f
        vis[v] = True
        for i, (to, rev, cap, cost) in enumerate(self.graph[v]):
            if cap > 0 and not vis[to] and dis[to] == dis[v] + cost:
                d = self.dfs(to, t, min(f, cap), dis, vis)
                if d > 0:
                    self.graph[v][i][2] -= d
                    self.graph[to][rev][2] += d
                    return d
        return 0

    def min_cost_flow(self, s, t):
        flow = 0
        cost = 0
        INF = self.INF
        while True:
            ok, dis = self.spfa(s, t)
            if not ok:
                break
            vis = [False] * self.n
            while True:
                f = self.dfs(s, t, INF, dis, vis)
                if f == 0:
                    break
                flow += f
                cost += f * dis[t]
                vis = [False] * self.n
        return cost

    for i in range(2, 111):
        node = 1 + (i-1)*n
        mcmf.add_edge(node, t, 10**9, 0)

        # forward edge

        # backward edge
        self.g[t].append({'to': s, 'rev': len(self.g[s]) - 1, 'f': 0, 'cap': 0, 'cost': -cost})

    def get_flow(self, s, t):
        flow = 0
        flowcost = 0
        while True:
            self.prio = [INF] * self.n
            self.prio[s] = 0
            self.curflow[s] = INF
            pq = [(0, s)]
            while pq:
                d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
                if d != self.prio[u]:
                    continue
                for i, e in enumerate(self.g[u]):
                    v = e['to']
                    if e['cap'] <= e['f']:
                        continue
                    nprio = self.prio[u] + e['cost'] + self.pot[u] - self.pot[v]
                    if self.prio[v] > nprio:
                        self.prio[v] = nprio
                        heapq.heappush(pq, (nprio, v))
                        self.prevnode[v] = u
                        self.prevedge[v] = i
                        self.curflow[v] = min(self.curflow[u], e['cap'] - e['f'])
            if self.prio[t] == INF:

            for i in range(self.n):
                self.pot[i] += self.prio[i]
            df = min(self.curflow[t], INF - flow)

            while v != s:

                e = self.g[u][self.prevedge[v]]
                e['f'] += df
                rev_e = self.g[v][e['rev']]
                rev_e['f'] -= df
                flowcost += df * e['cost']
                v = u
        return flow, flowcost

    head = [0] * (pct + 1)  # will be resized later
    edges = []  # list of (b, l, c, ne)

    def add_edge(a, b, c, l):
        nonlocal pct, head, edges
        # forward edge
        edges.append((b, l, c, head[a]))
        head[a] = len(edges) - 1
        # reverse edge
        edges.append((a, 0, -c, head[b]))
        head[b] = len(edges) - 1

    # Build nodes

            if j > 1:
                add_edge(id[i][j - 1], id[i][j], 0, 10**9)
        if cnt[i]:
            add_edge(S, id[i][1], 0, cnt[i])

    # Add roads
    for a, b in roads:
        for j in range(1, max_time):  # j from 1 to K+M+1 inclusive
            for k in range(1, 2 * K, 2):
                add_edge(id[a][j], id[b][j + 1], k * D, 1)
                add_edge(id[b][j], id[a][j + 1], k * D, 1)

    # Min-cost max-flow
    INF = 10**9
    dis = [0] * (pct + 1)
    inq = [False] * (pct + 1)
    flag = [False] * (pct + 1)

    def spfa():
        for i in range(1, pct + 1):
            dis[i] = INF
            inq[i] = False
        dis[S] = 0
        q = [S]
        inq[S] = True
        while q:
            p = q.pop(0)
            inq[p] = False
            i = head[p]
            while i:
                b, l, c, ne = edges[i]
                if l > 0 and dis[b] > dis[p] + c:
                    dis[b] = dis[p] + c
                    if not inq[b]:
                        q.append(b)
                        inq[b] = True
                i = ne
        return dis[E] < INF

    def dinic(x, y):
        if x == S:
            return y
        flag[x] = True
        tmp = y
        i = head[x]
        while i:
            b, l, c, ne = edges[i]
            rev = edges[i ^ 1]
            if not flag[b] and rev[1] > 0 and dis[x] < dis[b] + rev[2]:

                    edges[i] = (b, l + re, c, ne)
                    if tmp == 0:
                        break
            i = ne
        return y - tmp

INF = 10**9

class Rib:
    __slots__ = ('b', 'u', 'c', 'f', 'back')
    def __init__(self, b, u, c, f, back):
        self.b = b
        self.u = u
        self.c = c
        self.f = f
        self.back = back

def add_rib(g, a, b, u, c):
    r1 = Rib(b, u, c, 0, len(g[b]))
    r2 = Rib(a, 0, -c, 0, len(g[a]))
    g[a].append(r1)
    g[b].append(r2)

        add_rib(g, n - 2, x * 101, 1, 0)

    for i in range(101):

        v = int(next(it)) - 1
        for j in range(100):

                add_rib(g, u * 101 + j, v * 101 + j + 1, 1, cost)
                add_rib(g, v * 101 + j, u * 101 + j + 1, 1, cost)

        q = deque()
        q.append(s)

        id[s] = 1

        while q:
            v = q.popleft()
            id[v] = 2
            for i, r in enumerate(g[v]):
                if r.f < r.u and dist[v] + r.c < dist[r.b]:
                    dist[r.b] = dist[v] + r.c
                    if id[r.b] == 0:

            g[v][r].f -= addflow
            cost += g[pv][pr].c * addflow

import heapq

class MCMF:
    def __init__(self, N):
        self.N = N
        self.graph = [[] for _ in range(N)]

    def add_edge(self, fr, to, cap, cost):
        forward = [to, len(self.graph[to]), cap, cost]
        backward = [fr, len(self.graph[fr]), 0, -cost]
        self.graph[fr].append(forward)
        self.graph[to].append(backward)

    def min_cost_flow(self, s, t, maxf):
        N = self.N
        INF = 10**18
        res = 0
        flow = 0
        potential = [0] * N
        while flow < maxf:
            dist = [INF] * N
            prevv = [-1] * N
            preve = [-1] * N
            dist[s] = 0
            heap = [(0, s)]
            while heap:
                d, v = heapq.heappop(heap)
                if dist[v] < d:
                    continue
                for i, e in enumerate(self.graph[v]):
                    if e[2] > 0:  # capacity > 0
                        nd = d + e[3] + potential[v] - potential[e[0]]
                        if dist[e[0]] > nd:
                            dist[e[0]] = nd
                            prevv[e[0]] = v
                            preve[e[0]] = i
                            heapq.heappush(heap, (nd, e[0]))
            if dist[t] == INF:
                break
            for v in range(N):
                if dist[v] < INF:
                    potential[v] += dist[v]
            # find augmentable flow
            d = maxf - flow
            v = t
            while v != s:
                e = self.graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]]
                d = min(d, e[2])
                v = prevv[v]
            flow += d
            # compute cost increment directly using original costs
            cost_inc = 0
            v = t
            while v != s:
                e = self.graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]]
                cost_inc += e[3] * d
                v = prevv[v]
            res += cost_inc
            # update residual capacities
            v = t
            while v != s:
                e = self.graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]]
                e[2] -= d
                rev = self.graph[v][e[1]]
                rev[2] += d
                v = prevv[v]
        return flow, res


def main():

    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)

    src = V - 2

    for i in range(N):

import heapq

class MinCostFlow:
    class Edge:
        __slots__ = ('v', 'c', 'w', 'r')
        def __init__(self, v, c, w, r):
            self.v = v
            self.c = c  # capacity
            self.w = w  # cost per unit flow
            self.r = r  # reverse edge index

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.N = n
        self.G = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add(self, u, v, c, w):
        i = len(self.G[u])
        j = len(self.G[v])
        self.G[u].append(self.Edge(v, c, w, j))
        self.G[v].append(self.Edge(u, 0, -w, i))

    def run(self, s, t, f):
        N = self.N
        res = 0
        H = [0] * N
        INF = 10**18
        while f > 0:
            D = [INF] * N
            D[s] = 0
            PV = [-1] * N
            PE = [-1] * N
            pq = [(0, s)]
            while pq:
                d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
                if D[u] < d:
                    continue
                for i, e in enumerate(self.G[u]):
                    if e.c > 0 and D[e.v] > D[u] + e.w + H[u] - H[e.v]:
                        D[e.v] = D[u] + e.w + H[u] - H[e.v]
                        heapq.heappush(pq, (D[e.v], e.v))
                        PV[e.v] = u
                        PE[e.v] = i
            if D[t] == INF:
                return -1
            for i in range(N):
                if D[i] < INF:
                    H[i] += D[i]
            d = f
            v = t
            while v != s:
                u = PV[v]
                e = self.G[u][PE[v]]
                d = min(d, e.c)
                v = u
            f -= d
            res += d * H[t]
            v = t
            while v != s:
                u = PV[v]
                e = self.G[u][PE[v]]
                e.c -= d
                rev = self.G[v][e.r]
                rev.c += d
                v = u
        return res

    if not data:

    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))

    for i in range(M):
        us[i] = int(next(it)) - 1
        vs[i] = int(next(it)) - 1

    mcf = MinCostFlow(N * 101 + 2)
    s = N * 101
    t = s + 1

    for a in A:
        mcf.add(s, a, 1, 0)

    for i in range(101):

                mcf.add(i * N + vs[j], (i + 1) * N + us[j], 1, cost)

    ans = mcf.run(s, t, K)

def min_cost_flow(graph, s, t, maxf=INF):
    n = len(graph)
    flow = 0
    cost = 0
    while flow < maxf:
        dist = [INF]*n
        inqueue = [False]*n
        prevv = [-1]*n
        preve = [-1]*n
        dist[s] = 0
        q = deque([s])
        inqueue[s] = True
        while q:
            v = q.popleft()
            inqueue[v] = False
            for i, e in enumerate(graph[v]):
                if e.cap > 0 and dist[e.to] > dist[v] + e.cost:
                    dist[e.to] = dist[v] + e.cost
                    prevv[e.to] = v
                    preve[e.to] = i
                    if not inqueue[e.to]:
                        q.append(e.to)
                        inqueue[e.to] = True
        if dist[t] == INF:
            break
        d = maxf - flow
        v = t
        while v != s:
            d = min(d, graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap)
            v = prevv[v]
        flow += d
        cost += d * dist[t]
        v = t
        while v != s:
            e = graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]]
            e.cap -= d
            graph[v][e.rev].cap += d
            v = prevv[v]
    return flow, cost

import sys
from collections import deque

class MCMF:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.head = [-1] * n
        self.to = []
        self.cap = []
        self.cost = []
        self.ne = []
        self.e = 0

    def add_edge(self, u, v, cap, cost):
        # forward edge
        self.to.append(v)
        self.cap.append(cap)
        self.cost.append(cost)
        self.ne.append(self.head[u])
        self.head[u] = self.e
        self.e += 1
        # reverse edge
        self.to.append(u)
        self.cap.append(0)
        self.cost.append(-cost)
        self.ne.append(self.head[v])
        self.head[v] = self.e
        self.e += 1

    def link(self, u, v, cap, cost):
        self.add_edge(u, v, cap, cost)

    def spfa(self, s, t):
        INF = 10 ** 18
        n = self.n
        dis = [INF] * n
        ing = [0] * n
        pre = [-1] * n
        dis[s] = 0
        q = deque([s])
        ing[s] = 1
        while q:
            c = q.popleft()
            ing[c] = 0
            k = self.head[c]
            while k != -1:
                if self.cap[k] > 0:
                    v = self.to[k]
                    if dis[c] + self.cost[k] < dis[v]:
                        dis[v] = dis[c] + self.cost[k]
                        pre[v] = k
                        if not ing[v]:
                            q.append(v)
                            ing[v] = 1
                k = self.ne[k]
        return pre, dis, dis[t] != INF

    def run(self, s, t):
        flow = 0
        mincost = 0
        INF = 10 ** 18
        while True:
            pre, dis, ok = self.spfa(s, t)
            if not ok:
                break
            # find bottleneck
            pl = INF
            p = t
            while p != s:
                k = pre[p]
                pl = min(pl, self.cap[k])
                p = self.to[k ^ 1]
            # augment
            p = t
            while p != s:
                k = pre[p]
                self.cap[k] -= pl
                self.cap[k ^ 1] += pl
                p = self.to[k ^ 1]
            mincost += pl * dis[t]
            flow += pl
        return flow, mincost


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    m = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))

    a = [0] * (k + 1)
    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        a[i] = int(next(it))

    mx = 100
    # assign node ids for each (node, time)
    cnt = 0
    id = [[0] * (mx + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(0, mx + 1):
            id[i][j] = cnt
            cnt += 1

    totalNodes = cnt + 2
    s = cnt       # source
    t = cnt + 1   # sink

    flow = MCMF(totalNodes)

    INF_CAP = 10 ** 9

    # read graph edges
    for _ in range(m):
        u = int(next(it))
        v = int(next(it))
        for j in range(mx):
            for h in range(1, k + 1):
                tmp = (h * h - (h - 1) * (h - 1)) * d
                flow.link(id[u][j], id[v][j + 1], 1, c + tmp)
                flow.link(id[v][j], id[u][j + 1], 1, c + tmp)

    # stay edges (wait)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):

import heapq

class MinCostMaxFlow:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.V = n
        self.G = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]  # 0-indexed, but we use up to V inclusive
        self.H = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.dis = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.Prev = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.PreE = [0] * (n + 1)

    def add_edge(self, fr, to, cap, cost):
        # forward edge
        self.G[fr].append([to, cap, cost, len(self.G[to])])
        # reverse edge
        self.G[to].append([fr, 0, -cost, len(self.G[fr]) - 1])

    def min_cost(self, s, t, f):
        flow = 0
        res = 0
        INF = 10**18
        self.H = [0] * (self.V + 1)
        while f > 0:
            # Dijkstra with potentials
            self.dis = [INF] * (self.V + 1)
            self.dis[s] = 0
            pq = [(0, s)]
            while pq:
                d, v = heapq.heappop(pq)
                if self.dis[v] < d:
                    continue
                for i, e in enumerate(self.G[v]):
                    to, cap, cost, rev = e
                    if cap > 0 and self.dis[to] > self.dis[v] + cost + self.H[v] - self.H[to]:
                        self.dis[to] = self.dis[v] + cost + self.H[v] - self.H[to]
                        self.Prev[to] = v
                        self.PreE[to] = i
                        heapq.heappush(pq, (self.dis[to], to))
            if self.dis[t] == INF:
                break
            for i in range(self.V + 1):
                self.H[i] += self.dis[i]
            d = f
            v = t
            while v != s:
                d = min(d, self.G[self.Prev[v]][self.PreE[v]][1])
                v = self.Prev[v]
            f -= d
            flow += d
            res += d * self.H[t]
            v = t
            while v != s:
                e = self.G[self.Prev[v]][self.PreE[v]]
                e[1] -= d
                rev = e[3]
                self.G[v][rev][1] += d
                v = self.Prev[v]
        return res

import heapq

class MinCostMaxFlow:
    class Edge:
        __slots__ = ('src', 'dst', 'rev', 'flow', 'cap', 'cost')
        def __init__(self, src, dst, rev, flow, cap, cost):
            self.src = src
            self.dst = dst
            self.rev = rev
            self.flow = flow
            self.cap = cap
            self.cost = cost

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.potential = [0] * n
        self.dist = [0] * n
        self.back = [None] * n

    def add_edge(self, src, dst, cap, cost):
        self.adj[src].append(self.Edge(src, dst, len(self.adj[dst]), 0, cap, cost))
        if src == dst:
            self.adj[src][-1].rev += 1
        self.adj[dst].append(self.Edge(dst, src, len(self.adj[src]) - 1, 0, 0, -cost))

    def rcost(self, e):
        return e.cost + self.potential[e.src] - self.potential[e.dst]

    def dijkstra(self, source, sink):
        oo = 10**18
        self.dist = [oo] * self.n
        self.back = [None] * self.n
        pq = [(0, source)]
        self.dist[source] = 0
        while pq:
            d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
            if self.dist[u] < d:
                continue
            if u == sink:
                break
            for e in self.adj[u]:
                if e.flow < e.cap and self.dist[e.dst] > self.dist[e.src] + self.rcost(e):
                    self.dist[e.dst] = self.dist[e.src] + self.rcost(e)
                    self.back[e.dst] = e
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (self.dist[e.dst], e.dst))
        return self.dist[sink]

    def max_flow(self, source, sink):
        flow = 0
        cost = 0
        for u in range(self.n):
            for e in self.adj[u]:
                e.flow = 0
        self.potential = [0] * self.n
        oo = 10**18
        while True:
            d = self.dijkstra(source, sink)
            if d >= oo:
                break
            for u in range(self.n):
                if self.dist[u] < self.dist[sink]:
                    self.potential[u] += self.dist[u] - self.dist[sink]
            f = 10**18
            e = self.back[sink]
            while e is not None:
                f = min(f, e.cap - e.flow)
                e = self.back[e.src]
            e = self.back[sink]
            while e is not None:
                e.flow += f
                self.adj[e.dst][e.rev].flow -= f
                e = self.back[e.src]
            flow += f
            cost += f * (self.potential[sink] - self.potential[source])
        return (flow, cost)

import sys
import heapq

# Constants (will be adjusted based on input)
N = 100010  # maximum nodes, but we'll compute dynamically
M = 1000010
INF = 1000000000
WINF = 1000000000

class Edge:
    __slots__ = ('nxt', 'to', 'f', 'w')
    def __init__(self, nxt, to, f, w):
        self.nxt = nxt
        self.to = to
        self.f = f
        self.w = w

# Global graph structures
head = [0]  # 1-indexed, head[0] unused
r = [None]  # 1-indexed, r[0] unused
cnt = 1
all_nodes = 0

def add(u, v, f, w):
    global cnt, head, r
    # forward edge
    r.append(Edge(head[u], v, f, w))
    head[u] = cnt
    cnt += 1
    # reverse edge
    r.append(Edge(head[v], u, 0, -w))
    head[v] = cnt
    cnt += 1

# Min-cost flow functions
def dij(s, t, cur, vis, dis, tag):
    # Dijkstra with potentials
    for i in range(1, all_nodes+1):
        dis[i] = WINF
        cur[i] = head[i]
        vis[i] = False
    dis[t] = 0
    pq = [(0, t)]
    while pq:
        d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if vis[u]:
            continue
        vis[u] = True
        i = head[u]
        while i:
            e = r[i]
            v = e.to
            w = tag[u] + r[i^1].w - tag[v]  # note: i^1 is reverse edge
            if r[i^1].f and dis[u] + w < dis[v]:
                dis[v] = dis[u] + w
                heapq.heappush(pq, (dis[v], v))
            i = e.nxt
    for i in range(1, all_nodes+1):
        tag[i] = min(tag[i] + dis[i], WINF)
    if not vis[s]:
        return False
    for i in range(1, all_nodes+1):
        vis[i] = False
    return True

def dfs(u, t, fl, cur, vis, tag):
    if u == t or fl == 0:
        return fl
    res = 0
    vis[u] = True
    i = cur[u]
    while i:
        e = r[i]
        v = e.to
        if e.f and not vis[v] and tag[v] + e.w == tag[u]:
            f = dfs(v, t, min(fl, e.f), cur, vis, tag)
            if f:
                e.f -= f
                r[i^1].f += f
                res += f
                fl -= f
                if fl == 0:
                    break
        i = e.nxt
        cur[u] = i
    vis[u] = False
    return res

def min_cost_flow(s, t):
    global all_nodes
    maxf = 0
    minw = 0
    # allocate arrays for current node count
    cur = [0] * (all_nodes + 1)
    vis = [False] * (all_nodes + 1)
    dis = [0] * (all_nodes + 1)
    tag = [0] * (all_nodes + 1)
    while dij(s, t, cur, vis, dis, tag):
        w = dfs(s, t, INF, cur, vis, tag)
        maxf += w
        minw += w * tag[s]
    return minw

def id_func(t, x):
    return t * n + x + 2

def work(t, n, k, c, d, g):
    global all_nodes, head, r, cnt
    all_nodes += n
    # ensure head array is large enough
    while len(head) <= all_nodes:
        head.append(0)
    for u in range(1, n+1):
        for v in g[u]:
            for p in range(1, k+1):

    d[s] = 0

            to = edges[eid].to
            length = edges[eid].cost + phi[v] - phi[to]

                self.edge[i].flow += Min
                self.edge[i ^ 1].flow -= Min
                cost += self.edge[i].cost * Min

    M = 0
    
    # Edge list for flow network

    vv = []
    uv = []
    cost = []
    cap = []
    
    def add_edge(u, v, capacity, w):
        nonlocal M
        uu.append(u)
        vv.append(v)
        uv.append(u ^ v)
        cost.append(w)
        cap.append(capacity)
        cap.append(0)
        M += 1
    
    adj_ = [[] for _ in range(N)]
    def add_edge_to_adj(h, dir):
        nonlocal M
        adj_[uu[h]].append((h * 2 + dir, h))
        adj_[vv[h]].append((h * 2 + 1 - dir, h))
    
    # Build flow network
    for i in range(n):
        for s in range(t - 1):
            u = i * t + s
            for j in adj[i]:
                v = j * t + s + 1
                for x in range(1, k + 1):

                    add_edge_to_adj(M - 1, 0)

            u = i * t + s
            v = u + 1
            add_edge(u, v, k, 0 if i == 0 else c)
            add_edge_to_adj(M - 1, 0)
    
    for h in range(k):
        add_edge(N - 1, ii[h] * t + 0, 1, 0)
        add_edge_to_adj(M - 1, 0)
    
    # Min-cost max-flow (successive shortest augmenting path)
    INF = 10**9
    # We'll use a simplified version with potentials
    pot = [0] * N
    dist = [INF] * N
    prev_edge = [-1] * N
    prev_dir = [-1] * N
    
    total_cost = 0
    flow = 0
    
    while True:
        dist = [INF] * N
        dist[N-1] = 0
        pq = [(0, N-1)]
        while pq:
            d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
            if dist[u] != d:
                continue
            for dir, h in adj_[u]:
                if cap[h * 2 + dir] > 0:
                    v = vv[h] if dir == 0 else uu[h]
                    w = cost[h] if dir == 0 else -cost[h]
                    nd = d + w + pot[u] - pot[v]
                    if nd < dist[v]:
                        dist[v] = nd
                        prev_edge[v] = h
                        prev_dir[v] = dir
                        heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, v))
        
        if dist[0] == INF:
            break
        
        # Update potentials
        for v in range(N):
            if dist[v] < INF:
                pot[v] += dist[v]
            else:
                pot[v] += dist[0]  # just to keep consistency
        
        # Augment one unit
        v = 0
        while v != N - 1:
            h = prev_edge[v]
            dir = prev_dir[v]
            # direction: 0 means forward edge from uu[h] to vv[h], 1 means reverse
            if dir == 0:
                cap[h * 2] -= 1
                cap[h * 2 + 1] += 1
                v = uu[h]
            else:
                cap[h * 2 + 1] -= 1
                cap[h * 2] += 1
                v = vv[h]
        
        flow += 1
    
    total_cost = 0
    for h in range(M):
        total_cost += cost[h] * cap[h * 2 + 1]  # flow on reverse edges
    print(total_cost)

        m = len(self.E)
        self.G[u].append(m - 2)
        self.G[v].append(m - 1)
    
    def BellmanFord(self):
        d = [INF] * self.n
        inq = [False] * self.n
        p = [0] * self.n
        a = [0] * self.n
        
        d[self.s] = 0
        inq[self.s] = True
        p[self.s] = 0
        a[self.s] = INF
        
        q = deque()
        q.append(self.s)
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            inq[u] = False
            for idx in self.G[u]:
                e = self.E[idx]
                if e.cap > e.flow and d[e.v] > d[u] + e.cost:
                    d[e.v] = d[u] + e.cost
                    p[e.v] = idx
                    a[e.v] = min(a[u], e.cap - e.flow)
                    if not inq[e.v]:
                        q.append(e.v)
                        inq[e.v] = True
        
        if d[self.t] == INF:
            return False
        self.flow = a[self.t]
        self.cost = d[self.t]
        u = self.t
        while u != self.s:
            e = self.E[p[u]]
            e.flow += a[self.t]
            self.E[p[u] ^ 1].flow -= a[self.t]
            u = e.u
        return True
    
    def Mincost(self, s, t):
        self.s = s
        self.t = t
        total_cost = 0
        total_flow = 0
        while self.BellmanFord():
            total_flow += self.flow
            total_cost += self.flow * self.cost
        return (total_flow, total_cost)

import sys
from collections import deque

def solve() -> None:
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    m = next(it)
    p = next(it)
    c = next(it)
    d = next(it)

    # node indices: 0 = source, 1..100*n = time-layer nodes, 100*n+1 = sink
    num_nodes = 100 * n + 2
    s = 0
    t = n * 99 + 1  # as in original code

    # graph adjacency: list of edge indices for each node
    graph = [[] for _ in range(num_nodes)]

    # edge data: parallel lists
    to = []
    cap = []
    cost = []
    rev = []  # index of reverse edge

    def add_edge(u: int, v: int, capacity: int, cst: int) -> None:
        # forward edge
        to.append(v)
        cap.append(capacity)
        cost.append(cst)
        rev.append(len(to) + 1)  # will be updated after reverse added
        graph[u].append(len(to) - 1)

        # reverse edge
        to.append(u)
        cap.append(0)
        cost.append(-cst)
        rev.append(len(to) - 2)  # index of forward edge
        graph[v].append(len(to) - 1)

    # read starting nodes and add source edges
    for _ in range(p):
        x = next(it)
        add_edge(s, 0 * n + x, 1, 0)  # zh(0, x) = 0*n + x

    # read edges (x[i], y[i])
    xs = [0] * (m + 1)
    ys = [0] * (m + 1)
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        xs[i] = next(it)
        ys[i] = next(it)

    INF = 10**18

    # build time-expanded network
    for i in range(100):  # i = 0..99
        # staying edges
        # node 1: infinite capacity, zero cost
        add_edge(i * n + 1, (i + 1) * n + 1, INF, 0)
        # other nodes: infinite capacity, cost c
        for j in range(2, n + 1):
            add_edge(i * n + j, (i + 1) * n + j, INF, c)

        # movement edges along given pairs
        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            u = xs[j]
            v = ys[j]
            for k in range(1, p + 1):
                cst = d * k * k - d * (k - 1) * (k - 1) + c
                # u -> v
                add_edge(i * n + u, (i + 1) * n + v, 1, cst)
                # v -> u
                add_edge(i * n + v, (i + 1) * n + u, 1, cst)

    # MCMF using SPFA
    dis = [INF] * num_nodes
    pre = [-1] * num_nodes
    last = [-1] * num_nodes
    flow = [0] * num_nodes
    vis = [False] * num_nodes

    def spfa() -> bool:
        for i in range(num_nodes):
            dis[i] = INF
            vis[i] = False
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        vis[s] = True
        dis[s] = 0
        flow[s] = INF
        pre[t] = -1

        while q:
            x = q.popleft()
            vis[x] = False
            for ei in graph[x]:
                if cap[ei] > 0 and dis[to[ei]] > dis[x] + cost[ei]:
                    dis[to[ei]] = dis[x] + cost[ei]
                    pre[to[ei]] = x
                    last[to[ei]] = ei
                    flow[to[ei]] = min(flow[x], cap[ei])
                    if not vis[to[ei]]:
                        vis[to[ei]] = True
                        q.append(to[ei])
        return pre[t] != -1

    mxf = 0
    mnc = 0
    while spfa():
        mxf += flow[t]
        mnc += flow[t] * dis[t]
        now = t
        while now != s:
            ei = last[now]
            cap[ei] -= flow[t]
            cap[rev[ei]] += flow[t]
            now = pre[now]

    print(mnc)

import sys
import math

def solve() -> None:
    n, k = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    allp = list(map(float, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        if abs(allp[i]) < 1e-6:
            out.append("0")
            continue
        
        # exclude i-th element
        p = [allp[j] for j in range(n) if j != i]
        m = n - 1
        size = 1 << m
        
        dp = [0.0] * size
        dp[0] = allp[i]
        ans = dp[0]
        
        for mask in range(1, size):
            sumP = 0.0
            sum_val = 0.0
            cnt = 0
            for t in range(m):
                if mask & (1 << t):
                    sumP += p[t]
                    sum_val += p[t] * dp[mask ^ (1 << t)]
                    cnt += 1
            dp[mask] = sum_val / (1.0 - sumP)
            if cnt < k:
                ans += dp[mask]
        
        out.append(str(ans))
    
    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(out) + " ")

def main() -> None:
    t = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip()) if sys.stdin.readline().strip() else 1
    # In original code t is set to 1, we can just call solve once

In one nuclear reactor of a research station an uncontrolled reaction is in progress and explosion which will destroy the whole station will happen soon.The station is represented by a square n × n divided into 1 × 1 blocks. Each block is either a reactor or a laboratory. There can be several reactors and exactly one of them will explode soon. The reactors can be considered impassable blocks, but one can move through laboratories. Between any two laboratories, which are in adjacent blocks, there is a corridor. Blocks are considered adjacent if they have a common edge.In each laboratory there is some number of scientists and some number of rescue capsules. Once the scientist climbs into a capsule, he is considered to be saved. Each capsule has room for not more than one scientist.The reactor, which is about to explode, is damaged and a toxic coolant trickles from it into the neighboring blocks. The block, which contains the reactor, is considered infected. Every minute the coolant spreads over the laboratories through corridors. If at some moment one of the blocks is infected, then the next minute all the neighboring laboratories also become infected. Once a lab is infected, all the scientists there that are not in rescue capsules die. The coolant does not spread through reactor blocks.There are exactly t minutes to the explosion. Any scientist in a minute can move down the corridor to the next lab, if it is not infected. On any corridor an unlimited number of scientists can simultaneously move in both directions. It is believed that the scientists inside a lab moves without consuming time. Moreover, any scientist could get into the rescue capsule instantly. It is also believed that any scientist at any given moment always has the time to perform their actions (move from the given laboratory into the next one, or climb into the rescue capsule) before the laboratory will be infected.Find the maximum number of scientists who will be able to escape.

import sys

import heapq

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    t = int(next(it))
    a = [['']*n for _ in range(n)]
    b = [['']*n for _ in range(n)]
    br = bc = -1
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            ch = next(it)
            a[i][j] = ch
            if ch == 'Z':
                br, bc = i, j
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            b[i][j] = next(it)

    Maxn = n
    Inf = 1000000000
    dy = [-1, 0, 1, 0]
    dx = [0, -1, 0, 1]

    # BFS1: compute bum (time to reach from zombie)
    bum = [[t]*Maxn for _ in range(Maxn)]
    bum[br][bc] = 0
    q = deque()
    q.append((br, bc))
    while q:
        v = q.popleft()
        d = bum[v[0]][v[1]]
        for i in range(4):
            u = (v[0] + dy[i], v[1] + dx[i])
            if 0 <= u[0] < n and 0 <= u[1] < n and a[u[0]][u[1]] != 'Y' and d + 1 < bum[u[0]][u[1]]:
                bum[u[0]][u[1]] = d + 1
                q.append(u)

    # Build flow network
    N = 2 * n * n + 2
    R = [[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
    neigh = [[] for _ in range(N)]

    # Source to a cells
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if a[i][j].isdigit() and a[i][j] > '0':
                v = i * n + j + 1
                cap = int(a[i][j])
                R[0][v] = cap
                neigh[0].append(v)
                neigh[v].append(0)

                # BFS2 from this cell
                dist = [[Inf]*Maxn for _ in range(Maxn)]
                pos = [[False]*Maxn for _ in range(Maxn)]
                dist[i][j] = 0
                pos[i][j] = True
                q = deque()
                q.append((i, j))
                while q:
                    vv = q.popleft()
                    d = dist[vv[0]][vv[1]]
                    pos[vv[0]][vv[1]] = (d <= bum[vv[0]][vv[1]])
                    if d >= bum[vv[0]][vv[1]]:
                        continue
                    for k in range(4):
                        uu = (vv[0] + dy[k], vv[1] + dx[k])
                        if 0 <= uu[0] < n and 0 <= uu[1] < n and a[uu[0]][uu[1]] != 'Y' and d + 1 < dist[uu[0]][uu[1]]:
                            dist[uu[0]][uu[1]] = d + 1
                            q.append(uu)

                # Connect to b cells that are reachable
                for i2 in range(n):
                    for j2 in range(n):
                        if pos[i2][j2] and b[i2][j2].isdigit() and b[i2][j2] > '0':
                            u = n * n + i2 * n + j2 + 1
                            R[v][u] = Inf
                            neigh[v].append(u)
                            neigh[u].append(v)

    # b cells to sink
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if b[i][j].isdigit() and b[i][j] > '0':
                u = n * n + i * n + j + 1
                cap = int(b[i][j])
                R[u][N-1] = cap
                neigh[u].append(N-1)
                neigh[N-1].append(u)

    # Max flow using Dijkstra-like augmenting path (max capacity)
    def getFlow():
        F = [0]*N
        P = [-1]*N
        F[0] = Inf
        pq = [(-Inf, 0)]  # max-heap via negative
        while pq:
            f_neg, v = heapq.heappop(pq)
            f = -f_neg
            if F[v] != f:
                continue
            for u in neigh[v]:
                if min(f, R[v][u]) > F[u]:
                    F[u] = min(f, R[v][u])
                    P[u] = v
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (-F[u], u))
        v = N - 1
        if F[v] == 0:
            return 0
        res = F[v]
        while v:
            u = P[v]
            R[u][v] -= res
            R[v][u] += res
            v = u
        return res

    total = 0
    while True:
        f = getFlow()
        if f == 0:
            break
        total += f
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

import sys
from collections import deque

MAX_SIZE = 7100
INF = 1000000000

class Maxflow:
    def __init__(self, max_size=MAX_SIZE):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self.edg = []           # list of edges: [from, to, flow, capacity]
        self.g = [[] for _ in range(max_size)]   # adjacency list of edge indices
        self.s = 0
        self.t = max_size - 2
        self.dist = [0] * max_size
        self.cur = [0] * max_size

    def addedge(self, from_, to_, capacity):
        e1 = [from_, to_, 0, capacity]
        e2 = [to_, from_, 0, 0]
        self.edg.append(e1)
        self.edg.append(e2)
        self.g[from_].append(len(self.edg) - 2)
        self.g[to_].append(len(self.edg) - 1)

    def bfs(self):
        visited = [0] * self.max_size
        self.dist = [0] * self.max_size
        q = deque()
        q.append(self.s)
        visited[self.s] = 1
        self.dist[self.s] = 0
        while q:
            v = q.popleft()
            for idx in self.g[v]:
                e = self.edg[idx]
                nxt = e[1]
                if not visited[nxt] and e[3] > e[2]:
                    self.dist[nxt] = self.dist[v] + 1
                    q.append(nxt)
                    visited[nxt] = 1
        return visited[self.t]

    def dfs(self, x, cp):
        if x == self.t or cp == 0:
            return cp
        flow = 0
        y = self.cur[x]
        while y < len(self.g[x]):
            idx = self.g[x][y]
            e = self.edg[idx]
            if self.dist[x] + 1 == self.dist[e[1]]:
                min_cap = min(cp, e[3] - e[2])
                newflow = self.dfs(e[1], min_cap)
                if newflow > 0:
                    e[2] += newflow
                    self.edg[idx ^ 1][2] -= newflow
                    flow += newflow
                    cp -= newflow
                    if cp == 0:
                        break
            y += 1
            self.cur[x] = y
        return flow

    def dinic(self):
        flow = 0
        while self.bfs():
            self.cur = [0] * self.max_size
            flow += self.dfs(self.s, INF)
        return flow


def BFS(x, y, n, g1, visited, dist):
    # reset visited and dist
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            visited[i][j] = False
            dist[i][j] = 10**9
    dist[x][y] = 0
    q = deque()
    q.append((x, y, 0))
    dx = [1, 0, 0, -1]
    dy = [0, 1, -1, 0]
    while q:
        cx, cy, d = q.popleft()
        if visited[cx][cy]:
            continue
        visited[cx][cy] = True
        dist[cx][cy] = d
        for i in range(4):
            tx = cx + dx[i]
            ty = cy + dy[i]
            if 1 <= tx <= n and 1 <= ty <= n and not visited[tx][ty] and g1[tx][ty] != 'Y':
                q.append((tx, ty, d+1))


def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    it = iter(input_data)
    n = int(next(it))
    t = int(next(it))
    # read g1
    g1 = [''] * (n+2)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        g1[i] = ' ' + next(it)  # 1-indexed
    # read g2
    g2 = [''] * (n+2)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        g2[i] = ' ' + next(it)

    # find start cell 'Z'
    sx = sy = 0
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            if g1[i][j] == 'Z':
                sx, sy = i, j
                break
        if sx:

    dist_grid = [[0]*(n+2) for _ in range(n+2)]

    mf = Maxflow(MAX_SIZE)
    mf.s = 0
    mf.t = MAX_SIZE - 2

    # helper to compute node index
    def idx(level, x, y):
        return level * n * n + (x-1) * n + y

    # target node offset
    tgt_offset = MAX_SIZE - 3 - n * n

    # initial layer (level 0)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            cell_idx = idx(0, i, j)
            if '0' <= g1[i][j] <= '9':
                mf.addedge(mf.s, cell_idx, ord(g1[i][j]) - ord('0'))

                mf.addedge(tgt_offset + cell_idx, mf.t, ord(g2[i][j]) - ord('0'))
            mf.addedge(cell_idx, tgt_offset + cell_idx, INF)

    dy = [0, 1, -1, 0]

        for i in range(1, n+1):
            for j in range(1, n+1):

                    continue
                for d in range(4):
                    tx = i + dx[d]
                    ty = j + dy[d]

import sys
from collections import deque
from functools import lru_cache

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    t = int(next(it))
    sci = [next(it) for _ in range(n)]
    lab = [next(it) for _ in range(n)]

    # Locate the alien start and collect scientist positions
    pos = []      # list of (x, y)
    lc = []       # lab digits
    sc = []       # sci digits
    rx = ry = -1
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            c = sci[i][j]
            if c == 'Z':
                rx, ry = i, j
            elif '0' <= c <= '9':
                pos.append((i, j))
                lc.append(ord(lab[i][j]) - ord('0'))
                sc.append(ord(c) - ord('0'))

    m = len(pos)

    # BFS from alien start to compute distances in the lab grid
    dx = [1, -1, 0, 0]
    dy = [0, 0, 1, -1]

    def good(x, y):
        return 0 <= x < n and 0 <= y < n and lab[x][y] != 'Y' and lab[x][y] != 'Z'

    INF = 10**9
    dist = [[INF] * n for _ in range(n)]
    vis = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    dist[rx][ry] = 0
    vis[rx][ry] = 1
    qx = deque([rx])
    qy = deque([ry])
    while qx:
        x = qx.popleft()
        y = qy.popleft()
        for k in range(4):
            nx = x + dx[k]
            ny = y + dy[k]
            if good(nx, ny) and not vis[nx][ny]:
                dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1
                vis[nx][ny] = 1
                qx.append(nx)
                qy.append(ny)

    # Memoized DFS to check if a scientist can reach a lab safely
    @lru_cache(maxsize=None)
    def dfs(x0, y0, x1, y1, ptr):
        if ptr > t:
            return 0
        if x0 == x1 and y0 == y1:
            return 1 if dist[x0][y0] >= ptr else 0
        if dist[x0][y0] <= ptr:
            return 0
        for k in range(4):
            nx = x0 + dx[k]
            ny = y0 + dy[k]
            if good(nx, ny) and dfs(nx, ny, x1, y1, ptr + 1):
                return 1
        return 0

    # Build flow network
    total_nodes = 2 * m + 2   # source=0, sink=2m+1, scientists 1..m, labs m+1..2m
    cap = [[0] * total_nodes for _ in range(total_nodes)]

    # source -> scientists
    for i in range(m):
        cap[0][i + 1] = sc[i]
    # labs -> sink
    for i in range(m):
        cap[m + 1 + i][2 * m + 1] = lc[i]

    # scientists -> labs if path exists
    for i in range(m):
        for j in range(m):
            if dfs(pos[i][0], pos[i][1], pos[j][0], pos[j][1], 0):
                cap[i + 1][m + 1 + j] = 1000

    # Max flow using Ford-Fulkerson (Edmonds-Karp)
    flow = 0
    source = 0
    sink = 2 * m + 1

    while True:
        par = [-1] * total_nodes
        par[source] = -2
        q = deque([source])
        while q:
            v = q.popleft()
            for i in range(total_nodes):
                if par[i] == -1 and cap[v][i] > 0:
                    par[i] = v
                    q.append(i)
        if par[sink] == -1:
            break

        # compute augmenting flow
        aug = 10**9
        u = sink
        while par[u] >= 0:
            v = par[u]
            aug = min(aug, cap[v][u])
            u = v

        # update residual network
        u = sink
        while par[u] >= 0:
            v = par[u]
            cap[v][u] -= aug
            cap[u][v] += aug
            u = v
        flow += aug

    print(flow)
